title: UPDATE: BudgetPix Debuts Adaptive Compute for Pixel Space Image Diffusion
summary:
A new research paper introduces a method called compute-adaptive tokenization that allows the BudgetPix image generator to scale its processing based on the complexity of visual content. This approach enables a single pixel-space diffusion model to operate across any available compute budget during the inference stage. Additionally, the Ostris AI Toolkit has added integration support for Iris-3B, a text-to-image model developed by Sperid Labs.

Iris-3B is a 3B parameter open weights model released under an Apache 2.0 license that bypasses traditional latent stages to produce image data. Unlike most current diffusion models, it does not use a Variational Autoencoder (VAE). The system was designed for general image generation as well as detail-critical vision tasks, including image restoration and depth estimation.
